items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: [Cossetti] took Louis' music, to keep Louis

ctx.x: And this must have been after that.

It was after that, because I remember when it came back to Louis and I was telling him all the scores, different scores that I had -- I think [Cossetti] had took Louis' -- do you know anything about that? [Cossetti] took Louis' music, to keep Louis -- see, when Louis got ready to leave, [Cossetti] --
